name: Simcoe County Heavyweight Title
epitaph: The promotion's own top singles prize, required by its own rules to be defended at least once a month.
notes: Rules stated in the federation's own rules and handbook post (3 February 2005); the reign recorded here is confirmed defended in SCCW's own 'Lightning Strikes' show-results post (27 February 2005 event date).

name: Barrie District Championship
epitaph: A singles prize contested among the promotion's own ranked top three challengers, changing hands in a three-way match on the promotion's 27 February 2005 show.
notes: Rules stated in the federation's own rules and handbook post (3 February 2005); the title change recorded here is from SCCW's own 'Lightning Strikes' show-results post (27 February 2005 event date).

notes: Rules stated in the federation's own rules and handbook post (3 February 2005); the reign recorded here is confirmed defended in SCCW's own 'Lightning Strikes' show-results post (27 February 2005 event date).
